diagnostics.message: module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_lambda_event_source_mapping.scale_up must wait for module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.scale_up to grant the execution role SQS polling permissions; referencing the function alone does not order policy creation, so mapping creation can fail with insufficient permissions.

module.runners.module.webhook:resource.aws_lambda_function.webhook should wait for module.runners.module.webhook:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured. Lambda needs the attached ENI permissions during VPC provisioning and teardown; the role reference does not order this attachment.

module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_up should wait for module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured, so ENI permissions exist before VPC provisioning and remain during teardown.

module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_down should wait for module.runners.module.runners:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_down_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured, so ENI permissions exist before VPC provisioning and remain during teardown.

module.runners.module.runners.module.pool:resource.aws_lambda_function.pool should wait for module.runners.module.runners.module.pool:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.pool_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured, so ENI permissions exist before VPC provisioning and remain during teardown.

module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_lambda_function.syncer should wait for module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured, so ENI permissions exist before VPC provisioning and remain during teardown.

module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_s3_object.trigger immediately invokes the syncer but does not wait for module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.syncer. Order the trigger after this policy so the initial synchronization can access the distribution object.

module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_s3_object.trigger should wait for module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_kms when a KMS key is configured; its upload immediately invokes the syncer, which needs the KMS permissions for encrypted distribution writes.
